articles.title: Are Harnesses Worth the Cost?
articles.snippet: Naresh Jain compares coding agents building the same API service with and without a behavioral harness. A frontier model, GPT-6 Sol, passed every external evaluation either way. But a cost-optimized model, GPT-6 Luna, succeeded in only 3 of 10 unharnessed runs and all 10 with the harness. While adding the harness increased token usage and runtime for Luna, the harnessed Luna runs achieved the same 10-for-10 reliability as GPT-6 Sol while costing 33% less per run ($0.273 vs $0.406). articles.title: Data Contracts
articles.snippet: Data contracts are a way to describe the contents and guarantees of datasets. Simon Harrer and Arif Wider describe in detail what they are and how to use them. They apply practices from API design to data by treating them as data-providing services - such as data products - whose interfaces we want to define as clearly as possible. articles.title: I don't like LLMs
articles.snippet: I have a lot of mixed feelings about AI and LLM technology. I’m fascinated by its effect on our profession, excited by the potential gains in productivity - and thus the products we could rapidly build. On the other hand, I’m fearful of the damage AI might cause: agent swarms taking over our virtual and physical infrastructure, designing bio weapons.
